title: Yellowed Chicken Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic Malaysian-inspired dish with tender yellowed chicken and fragrant biryani rice.

ingredients.name: Biryani Spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves

instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic. Cook until onion is translucent.
Add marinated chicken and cook until browned.
Add biryani spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add rice and water. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Cook the chicken to an internal temperature of 74°C (165°F).
Check the rice for doneness and fluff with a fork before serving.
